name: Thirst
description:
Thirst is a learning platform with an AI copilot built in, used by businesses to keep onboarding, compliance and training on track. The Thirst connector links a user's own Thirst account via OAuth, so Claude can work inside their real learning data.

With this connector, users can:
- **Learn actively, not passively:** summarise content, get it re-explained a different way, quiz themselves, or run a roleplay scenario to practise a skill, all without leaving what they're viewing.
- **Find what's relevant:** search the whole content library by topic, get recommendations tailored to what they want to learn, or get auto-assigned to a course based on their role, skills and interests.
- **Understand why it matters:** see how a specific piece of content connects to their actual job, and get suggested next skills based on their progress so far.
- **Stay on top of training:** get a digest of what's new, overdue, or coming up whether that's for themselves as a learner, for their team as a manager, or across the whole org as an admin.
- **Create and structure learning content:** auto-tag uploads with the right skills, generate quizzes from uploaded material, auto-generate titles and blurbs, and sequence content into a learning journey that follows existing conventions.
- **Keep the content library healthy:** flag content that's unlinked to skills, getting low engagement, or duplicating other material in the library.
- **Set up the platform conversationally:** create new spaces, add users individually or in bulk, and help newly added users get onboarded.

All actions run against the authenticated user's Thirst account, and respect Thirst's permission model - the connector can only see and change what the signed-in user could see & change in thirst.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Thirst to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Thirst to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://agents.thirst.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Thirst MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Thirst provides these MCP tools: Thirst___api_discover, Thirst___rest_details, Thirst___rest_read, Thirst___rest_write, and x_amz_bedrock_agentcore_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Thirst?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Thirst in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.
Thirst requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Thirst is developed by Thirst Learning. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
